meta: Aqua HK halved Meta to HK$6,607 for 18 schedules (~HK$367 CPA), a sharp efficiency gain on the prior week's HK$12,246 for 15.
Dim Sum Library lifted Meta to HK$2,293 for 8 schedules (~HK$287 CPA), up from HK$960 for 7, still inside the mid band.
Meta stays a thin last-click channel: 26 combined schedules against 343 GA4 bookings.
google: Aqua HK Google ran HK$9,261 for ~71 booking conversions at ~HK$131 CPA, back in the good band.
Dim Sum Library Google delivered ~68 conversions on HK$3,697 at ~HK$54 CPA, the cheapest acquisition in the portfolio.
Google drove ~139 of the two venues' 343 bookings, around two fifths of the combined total.
ga4: Aqua HK eased to 194 bookings from 196, 13% under the raised August target of 224 and still -6.9% on YTD; user CVR held near 6.3%.
Dim Sum Library slipped to 149 from 170 (-12% WoW, -14% YoY), 18% under target and -6.4% YTD, though users rose to 1,231.
DSL's ~12% user CVR stays strong so its gap is traffic-side; Aqua's ~6% CVR means its gap is conversion-side.
